One word. Every computer you own.
You taught it in one sentence. No app, no settings, no code.

A real run on a real home setup: 3.0 seconds. Device names made generic.

Three things.

It listens.

Talk naturally. One thing at a time, in your own words. No commands to learn, no skill to pick first. It picks.

It thinks out loud.

Before it starts, it tells you what it's about to do. No guessing what it heard.

It asks first.

Sending, texting, paying. Nothing leaves the house without your yes.

No other voice assistant can learn a new trick from one sentence and run it across every computer you own.

These aren't three features.
It's one advocate. And it works for you.

For the things that matter to you.

At home

“Did the dog eat today? If not, remind me at five.”

I'll check, “Did the dog eat today?” If not, I'll remind you at five. Sound good?

At work

“Bring my inbox and sort it. Is anything urgent? If yes, draft a reply and send it to me. If no, stop.”

First I'll start with your inbox, then sort it, and then check whether anything is urgent. If so, I'll draft a reply and send it to you. I'll ask you before anything goes out. Sound good?

With your kids

“Quiz my son on his 7 times table. Keep going until he gets ten in a row right. Text me how it went.”

First I'll quiz your son on his 7 times table, and keep going until he gets ten in a row right, and then text you how it went. I'll ask you before anything goes out. Sound good?

For the ideas too hard to try.

Everyone has a graveyard of ideas. Not bad ones. Ones that died because the first step was too hard, too slow, or needed someone you didn't have. The Brainstem is for the moment a new thought arrives: say it, watch it think, and see it tried before the doubt sets in. It finds the question you didn't know to ask. That is why it exists. Everything else on this page is a bonus.

And it's yours.

What it learns lives as plain files on your computer, not in someone else's cloud. Change AI services tomorrow and everything you taught it comes with you. It isn't another layer on top of your AI tools. It's the floor they stand on.

One more thing.

It works on any screen.

The same words that work out loud work on the apps you already use. Ask it to finish a form, and it tells you what it sees before it touches anything.

Find the save button on the form you filled out for me. Press save.
First I'll find the save button on the form I filled out for you, and then press save. I'll ask you before anything goes out. Sound good?
Go.
I see a save button on the form I filled out for you. Should I press it?
Get your Brainstem

The Brainstem runs on RAPP.

Yours in 20 minutes.

Open GitHub Copilot Chat in VS Code (or any AI you like) and paste this one line. It does the rest while you watch.

Go and read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/docs/start/skill.md and set up my Brainstem for me.

It installs your Brainstem, checks that it really works, opens it right inside VS Code, and teaches it its first trick with you.

Or one line for anything.

No setup at all. Every line here has the same shape: go and read this, then do that. Change the ending to what you need.

Go and read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/docs/start/business-prompting.md and sort my inbox for me.

Talking in short plain plans also keeps every chat small, so each answer costs fewer tokens than a wall of instructions.
